title: Password policy check plus a check counter
task: Package `auth` needs a password policy: at least 12 characters, at least one digit, at least one letter, and not in a small built-in list of banned passwords. Callers ask whether a candidate passes and, when it fails, want every rule it broke. We would also like to count how many checks have been run, for metrics; keep that from sneaking into the policy check itself. Test a passing password and one that fails two rules at once.
